title: Ahmed body: an end-to-end CFD surrogate study
description: OpenFOAM k-omega SST campaign on the Ahmed body (mesh study, validation against Ahmed et al. 1984, maximin DOE), surrogate families at equal budget with cross-conformal intervals and physics checks, Sobol indices, a verified Pareto front, acquisition against random runs, an amortised inverse on the wind-tunnel drag, a digital twin and an evidence report.
